mapper.select:
select pecd.pecd_Id as pecdId, pecd.pec_Id as pecId, c.C_Name as peCompanyName, c.C_Name_History as peCompanyNameHistory, d.D_Name as peUnitName, pc.C_Name as pBuildUnitName, c.C_Abbreviation as peCompanyAbbName, pc.C_Abbreviation as pConsAbbName, prod.D_Name as pCompDepName, case when p.Pe_Contract_Category='02' then sr.Sc_Name else con.con_Name end as conName, case when p.Pe_Contract_Category='02' then sr.Sc_Money else con.con_Money_Total end as conMoneyTotal, case when p.Pe_Contract_Category='02' then sr.Sc_Type else con.con_Type end as conType, case when p.Pe_Contract_Category='02' then sr.Sc_Code else con.con_Code end as conCode, con.Con_Execution as conExecution, pro.P_Name as pName, pro.P_Name_History as pNameHistory,
from Pe_Info_Collect_Dtl pecd left join Pe_Info_Collect pec on pec.pec_Id=pecd.pec_Id left join Pe_Info p on pecd.pe_id=p.Pe_id left join Con_Contract con on p.Pe_Con_Id=con.Con_Id left join Pre_Project pro on pro.P_Id=p.Pe_Project_Id left join SYS_Company c on c.C_Id=p.Pe_Company_Id left join SYS_Department d on d.D_Id=p.Pe_Unit_Id left join SYS_Company pc on pc.C_Id=pro.P_Construction_Unit left join SYS_Department prod on prod.D_Id=pro.P_Competent_Department left join Subcontract_Record sr on p.Pe_Sub_Contract=sr.Sc_Id where pecd.pec_Id=#{pecId}
